About Smart Impact Analyzer

Smart Impact Analyzer is an AI-based software requirement change impact analysis system that helps developers and project managers understand the effects of requirement changes in a software project.

The system analyzes requirement modifications and identifies affected modules, dependencies, and possible risks using Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning techniques.

Project Highlights
